entries.en: Hell if I know. I hope we've bled them. But that's tight quarters, and their territory.
If you want to take a throw at it, we'll give you the coordinates. But it's your call.
You saved our asses, Commander. Thanks.
How are those repairs coming?
We'll hold.
Not much time left, Commander.
First Lieutenant Durand, ma'am.
First Lieutenant Durand, sir.
Third Brigade, 14th Infantry Regiment. And I am damned glad to see you.
Shepard, Normandy. Give me a sit-rep.
They're not animals. They're a sentient species. You study history? They're called rachni.
Why are you out here in the first place?
If that's all they had left, you must have done a lot of killing before we got here.
We've taken care of the immediate problem. Do you think you can hold this position?
Do what you can to secure your position. We'll see if we can get some of your defenses operational.
Secure those negative waves, Durand. You and me are going to hold this worthless rock. Look to your people. We'll see if we can fix your defenses.
Then we don't have much time. I'll see if any of your defenses can be salvaged. Dig in as best you can.
Never mind me. Are you all right?
I'm pissed off. When I get pissed off, I shoot things. Find me more bugs.
I'll live. You?
Just point us in the right direction.
I have another mission I need to complete. I can't do it for you.
What sort of opposition would you expect?
We heard you needed some backup.
Hell of a welcome. How did it get this bad?
How are you?
Just getting warmed up.
We'll take care of it.
We have to go.
Threat assessment?
We're here to help.
Report.
They're intelligent.
Your presence
There weren't many of them.
Can you hold now?
We'll help.
That's defeatist talk.
We'd better get ready.
There's one other thing I should mention. One of our other listening posts went offline three days ago.
I don't know if it's coincidence, a pirate raid, or what. But if you want to check in on them...
Yeah, but that was an Alliance ship, Commander. I mean, it was a drone. Running on automatics. But what--?
We've seen this before. It's a long story.
We've seen this before. It's a long story, Lieutenant.
We don't have time to explain. Are you secure here?
Will the rachni come back?
This isn't the first time we've seen this. Will your unit be all right here?
Wouldn't do much good. They're moving around deep underground. The only time they come near the surface, and they're right on our position.
You bombard them, you take us out, too.
They're called rachni. You get a supply ship in recently?
We do have a ship in orbit. We could bombard them.
The supply ships.
Bombardment
Yeah, could be that, too. Maybe I'm paranoid. I've been up too long.
We'll check on them. I don't know why there are rachni loose out here, but I intend to find out.
It could also be that their link to the Comm Net is down.
Between the Citadel and the Fifth Fleet, everyone wants a piece of us. I'll see if we can divert.
We'll swing by.
It's probably nothing.
If we have time.
